name: @pipeworx/mcp-octopart

tools.name: octopart_search
tools.description: Search Octopart for electronic components by manufacturer part number (MPN) or keyword. Returns matching parts with manufacturer, category, median price, total availability, and distributor offers (stock, price breaks, MOQ, lead time). Example: octopart_search({ q: "STM32F407", limit: 5, _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

q.description: Manufacturer part number or keyword, e.g. "STM32F407VGT6", "0.1uF 0603 capacitor"

limit.description: Max number of parts to return (default 5, max 20)

country.description: ISO country code for pricing/availability context, e.g. "US" (optional)

currency.description: ISO currency code for converted prices, e.g. "USD" (optional)

_apiKey.description: Nexar OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret". Get a free key ("Welcome 1K" plan) at https://portal.nexar.com

tools.name: octopart_multi_match
tools.description: Batch-match a list of manufacturer part numbers in one call — ideal for BOM (bill of materials) enrichment. Each query resolves to the best-matching part(s) with distributor offers. Example: octopart_multi_match({ mpns: ["SY89832UMG", "SY89874UMG"], limit: 1, _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

mpns.description: List of manufacturer part numbers to match (exact-match), e.g. ["SY89832UMG", "GRM188R71C104KA01D"]

limit.description: Max parts to return per MPN (default 1)

country.description: ISO country code for pricing/availability context, e.g. "US" (optional)

currency.description: ISO currency code for converted prices, e.g. "USD" (optional)

_apiKey.description: Nexar OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret". Get one at https://portal.nexar.com

tools.name: octopart_part
tools.description: Get full detail for a single electronic part by exact MPN: every distributor seller with offers (price breaks, inventory level, MOQ, factory lead time), technical specs, availability, datasheet URL, and Octopart page. Example: octopart_part({ mpn: "LM317T", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

country.description: ISO country code for pricing/availability context, e.g. "US" (optional)

currency.description: ISO currency code for converted prices, e.g. "USD" (optional)

_apiKey.description: Nexar OAuth2 credentials as "client_id:client_secret". Get one at https://portal.nexar.com

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-octopart forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the octopart pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
